versions.changelog:
Initial release of Notion API skill.

- Provides documentation and usage examples for interacting with the Notion API, including creating, reading, and updating pages, databases (data sources), and blocks.
- Details setup instructions for obtaining and storing an API key and connecting integrations to Notion pages and databases.
- Highlights API basics, including HTTP request formats and required headers (uses Notion version 2025-09-03).
- Documents common API operations: searching, reading, creating, querying, and updating pages/data sources, as well as adding content blocks.
- Explains new terminology in API version 2025-09-03: “databases” are now “data sources,” with corresponding new endpoints and dual ID system.
- Lists supported property types for database items and outlines relevant API notes and limitations.
